SOFTWARE_REFERENCE.note: Sampled numerical model only; 0.125 source px is an engineering target, not an enterprise threshold.

LENS_RTL.requirement: Nonzero k1/k2/p1/p2 individually; independent float/fixed/RTL coordinates and sampled pixels; H-only negative controls.
LENS_RTL.note: Independent sequential numeric baseline; no real calibration,board integration,video throughput or changed PDS timing qualification.

PARAM_COMMIT.requirement: Complete K and lens bank validation; dimensions/mode/version/H association; atomic frame-boundary commit, reset/collision/in-flight ownership.
PARAM_COMMIT.note: Independent sequential numeric baseline; no real calibration,board integration,video throughput or changed PDS timing qualification.

H_LENS_COMPOSITION.requirement: Undistort raw corners before H fitting; target through ideal H then forward lens distortion; one final image sample.
H_LENS_COMPOSITION.note: Independent sequential numeric baseline; no real calibration,board integration,video throughput or changed PDS timing qualification.

REAL_CALIBRATION.requirement: Traceable real raw images, camera/lens/mode/settings, K/k1/k2/p1/p2, target geometry, estimator/options, view hashes and errors; disjoint calibration/test captures.

HELD_OUT_QUALITY.requirement: Independent black/white target captures; MTF50 or SFR, straightness, edge stretch/breaks, physical aspect evidence, declared measurement methods and uncertainty.

LOCAL_FRAME_COMPOSITION.requirement: Same input/output dimensions; actual paper/pad outer boundary; unchanged outside pixels except complete old-marker cleanup; justified target aspect,background fill,actual text-baseline checks and single final sampling with coherent source-frame metadata.

REALTIME_RESOURCES.requirement: Actual corrected new-image rate, end-to-end hardware latency, LUT/register/DSP use, native16:9 source, real movement/angle changes and persistent stability.

LENS_PDS.requirement: Final changed lens-inclusive RTL exact source SHA, all final timing constraints, bit/mask and actual hardware acceptance evidence.

V5C_scope: H-only/RAW board candidate; cannot qualify lens-inclusive RTL or real lens quality
policy: Missing or unreviewed evidence blocks acceptance; arbitrary JSON pass flags do not grant release. No enterprise numeric thresholds invented.
